findings: Event buses are ephemeral SharedFlows with default replay zero; file modification currently has only FilesDeleted. They are not a persisted invalidation log and cannot by themselves observe external same-path rewrites. Subscriber reconciliation remains unread.
App resume uses tryEmit and ignores its boolean result. Folder updates have extraBufferCapacity one but no replay; actual event loss/backpressure depends on subscribers and has not been tested.

ProactiveIndexer enqueues unique one-time work with KEEP and storage-not-low constraint. It does not configure charging/idle constraints or a true scheduler priority despite low-priority wording. No device work scheduled.

Exponential backoff is configured, but worker catches Exception and returns Result.failure rather than retry. Transient failures therefore do not request the configured backoff retry through this path.

Worker reports success after thumbnailPrewarmer.prewarm returns. Completion meaning depends on prewarmer implementation, not yet read. Broad catch also includes coroutine cancellation; WorkManager cancellation semantics unqualified.
